validation_method: One compact and one full five-security batch were requested in an isolated Alibaba Cloud container during the same A-share session. Candidate indices had to satisfy positive prices, percentage formula agreement, compact/full percentage agreement and one common index tuple across all five securities.

evidence_summary.reason: The initial numerical-only scan found two current candidates. That result is retained as historical evidence and is superseded as a decision rule by the semantic-anchor run below. No complete upstream response is stored in Git.

compact_cross_validation: 2026-08-04 isolated-cloud run: 510300 and 600111 passed all anchors; 300308 failed p3/p31 compact comparisons because the two sequential snapshots differed by 0.12. The mismatch exceeded the research display-precision tolerance, so no current-field contract was promoted.
composite_field_validation: p3 equalled the first p35 price component for 510300, 300308 and 600111.
minute_endpoint_validation: The last same-day Tencent minute price was within the configured price tolerance of p3 for all three instruments.
redundant_field_observations: p78 was non-empty and distinct for 510300, empty for 300308 and 600111. It is observational only and never a fallback.
